sources.location: RAW headers read by HTTP range request (instrument string; see scratchpad/PXD030043/evidence/raw_header_check.json)

claims.value: fetal liver HSPC: TMT127 = free thiols (SH), TMT131 = reversibly oxidized (Sox); adult bone marrow HSPC: TMT126 = SH, TMT128 = Sox
claims.evidence: Fig. 1a: 'iTMT127/126 blocking', 'iTMT131/128 blocking'; fetal oxidation = 131/(127+131), adult = 128/(126+128)

claims.value: 1 = full, 2 = anti-TMT flow-through, 3 = anti-TMT enriched; replicates 01–03
claims.evidence: RAW names KP086_full0N / FT0N / E0N; 'Full, enriched and flow-through fractions of each replicate were jointly processed'

claims.value: Lin− Sca-1+ c-Kit+ HSPCs; E14.5 fetal liver vs adult bone marrow; C57BL/6N

claims.evidence: 'Adult mice used in experiments were 10–20 weeks old'; 'For proteome analysis, equal numbers of male and female mice were used'

claims.value: iodoTMT6plex on C as the isobaric label (annotated Fixed, SDRF convention for TMT labels; the authors set no other fixed modification); Ox M, Acetyl N-term variable; 20 ppm / 0.5 Da

limitations: Each HSPC replicate is pooled from several sorts (Supplementary Fig. 2a) of equal numbers of male and female mice, so sex = pooled; adult mice were 10–20 weeks old, fetal age is captured by the E14.5 developmental stage.
The two thiol pools of one lysate are separate source names (…_SH, …_Sox); the pool is described in characteristics[treatment].
reconcile reads only one of the two cleavage-agent columns (Trypsin and Lys-C are both annotated).
The validator warns that 'pooled' is not in the installed vertebrates template's sex list; the SDRF spec (README, TERMS.tsv) allows 'pooled' for pooled samples.
